Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Be willing and able to provide written informed consent for the trial.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has obtained written informed consent, as explicitly stated in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Be a male or female subject greater than or equal to 18 years of age on day of signing informed consent.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's age is not provided in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have locally confirmed TNBC, as defined by the most recent ASCO/CAP guidelines.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information provided about the patient's TNBC status in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have previously untreated locally advanced non-metastatic (M0) TNBC defined as the following combined primary tumor (T) and regional lymph node (N) staging per the current AJCC Version 8 staging criteria for breast cancer staging criteria as assessed by the investigator based on radiological and/or clinical assessment: - T1c, N1-N2 - T2, N0-N2 - T3, N0-N2 - T4a-d, N0-N2 Note: bilateral tumors (i.e., synchronous cancers in both breasts) and/or multi-focal (i.e., 2, separate lesions in the same quadrant)/multi-centric (i.e., 2 separate lesions in different quadrants) tumors are allowed, as well as inflammatory breast cancer, and the tumor with the most advanced T stage should be used to assess the eligibility.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's TNBC staging is not provided in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Provide a core needle biopsy consisting of at least 1 separate tumor-bearing cores from the primary tumor at screening for translational research (archival is acceptable if sufficient tumor is available; slides are acceptable if at least 15 are available).
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about the patient providing a core needle biopsy in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0 or 1 assessed within 14 days of treatment initiation.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's ECOG performance status is not mentioned in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Demonstrate adequate organ function. All screening labs should be performed within 14 days of treatment initiation.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about the patient's organ function or screening labs in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Have left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) of ≥50% or ≥ institution lower limit of normal (LLN) as assessed by echocardiogram (ECHO) or multigated acquisition (MUGA) scan performed at screening.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's LVEF is not provided in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Males and female subjects of childbearing potential (Section 5.7.2 - Contraception) must be willing to use an adequate method of contraception as outlined in Section 5.7.2 - Contraception, for the course of the study through 12 months after the last dose of study medication for subjects who have received cyclophosphamide, and 6 months after the last dose of study medication for subjects who did not. Note: Abstinence is acceptable if this is the usual lifestyle and preferred contraception for the subject.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient's willingness or method of contraception is not mentioned in the patient description.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: (Female subject of childbearing potential) Have a negative urine or serum pregnancy test within 72 hours prior to receiving the first dose of study medication. If the urine test is positive or borderline a serum pregnancy test will be required.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male, as indicated by the presence of bilateral cryptorchidism, making this criterion irrelevant.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a history of invasive malignancy ≤5 years prior to signing informed consent except for adequately treated basal cell or squamous cell skin cancer or in situ cervical cancer.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about a history of invasive malignancy in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has received prior chemotherapy, targeted therapy, and radiation therapy within the past 12 months.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about prior chemotherapy, targeted therapy, or radiation therapy in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has received prior therapy with an anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 agent or with an agent directed to another co-inhibitory T-cell receptor (e.g., CTLA-4, OX 40, CD137) or has previously participated in MK-3475 clinical trials.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about prior therapy with these agents or participation in MK-3475 clinical trials in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is currently participating in or has participated in an interventional clinical trial with an investigational compound or device within 4 weeks of the first dose of treatment in this current trial. Note: subject should be excluded if he/she received an investigational agent with anti-cancer or anti-proliferative intent within the last 12 months.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about participation in other clinical trials in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has received a live vaccine within 30 days of the first dose of study treatment. Note: Seasonal influenza vaccines for injection are generally inactivated flu vaccines and are allowed; however intranasal influenza vaccines (e.g., FluMist®) are live attenuated vaccines, and are not allowed.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about recent vaccinations in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has an active autoimmune disease that has required systemic treatment in past 2 years (i.e., with use of disease modifying agents, corticosteroids or immunosuppressive drugs). Replacement therapy (e.g., thyroxine, insulin, or physiologic corticosteroid replacement therapy for adrenal or pituitary insufficiency) is not considered a form of systemic treatment.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about an active autoimmune disease or systemic treatment in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a diagnosis of immunodeficiency or is receiving systemic steroid therapy or any other form of immunosuppressive therapy within 7 days prior to the first dose of trial treatment.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about immunodeficiency or immunosuppressive therapy in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a known history of Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) (HIV 1/2 antibodies).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about a history of HIV in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has known active Hepatitis B (e.g., HBsAg reactive) or Hepatitis C (e.g., HCV RNA [qualitative] is detected).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about active Hepatitis B or C in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a history of (non-infectious) pneumonitis that required steroids or current pneumonitis.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about a history of pneumonitis in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has an active infection requiring systemic therapy.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about an active infection in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has significant cardiovascular disease, such as: - History of myocardial infarction, acute coronary syndrome or coronary angioplasty/stenting/bypass grafting within the last 6 months - Congestive heart failure (CHF) New York Heart Association (NYHA) Class II-IV or history of CHF NYHA class III or IV
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has a ventricular septal defect, but there is no information about significant cardiovascular disease as defined by the exclusion criteria.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a history or current evidence of any condition, therapy, lab abnormality or other circumstance that might expose the subject to risk by participating in the trial, confound the results of the trial, or interfere with the subject's participation for the full duration of the trial in the opinion of the Investigator.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient has multiple congenital conditions, but it is unclear if these would expose the subject to risk or interfere with trial participation without further assessment by the investigator.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has known psychiatric or substance abuse disorders that would interfere with cooperation with the requirements of the trial in the opinion of the Investigator.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about psychiatric or substance abuse disorders in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Is pregnant or breastfeeding, or expecting to conceive children within the projected duration of the trial, starting with the screening visit through 12 months after the last dose of trial treatment for subjects who have received cyclophosphamide, and for 6 months after the last dose of study medication for subjects who have not.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: The patient is male, making this criterion irrelevant.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a known hypersensitivity to the components of the study therapy or its analogs.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about hypersensitivity to study therapy components in the patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Has a known history of active TB (Bacillus Tuberculosis).
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: There is no information about a history of active TB in the patient description.
There is no information about an allergy to ciprofloxacin or other quinolones in the patient description.

Recap: The patient meets the criterion for providing written informed consent. However, there is insufficient information to determine eligibility based on age, TNBC status, and other medical criteria. The patient is male, making certain criteria irrelevant. There is no information suggesting violation of exclusion criteria.
